description: Skill selection eval cases for assessment orchestration skills.

cases.prompt: An email notification arrived from the agent mailbox. Turn it into a validated assessment job.
Resolve this SharePoint URL into a canonical target object before retrieval.
This is a user-initiated request. Verify delegated mode and prevent app-only fallback.
Fetch the target body, metadata, owner and last editor from the provider through MCP.
Retrieve Corpus A controls and Corpus B guidance to prepare grounding evidence for assessment.
Generate a structured compliance report with findings, citations, and missing evidence markers.
Pick inline comment, email, or fallback channels based on delivery policy and provider capability.
Execute the delivery plan and publish comments and email outcomes through MCP servers.
Persist stage-level trace records with correlation ID so the full assessment can be reconstructed.
